notes: Dodging is snappier: the cooldown is shorter (0.6 s → 0.38 s), the dodge is a bit faster and goes further, it leaves a cyan afterimage, and a dodge pressed a moment too early (in recovery, in the cooldown, or still stunned) now comes out as soon as it can instead of being lost. Cooldowns: counter 1.15 → 0.95 s, medium/heavy minimum 0.6 → 0.5 s, and attack presses stay buffered a little longer so mashing through combos is cleaner. Every fight key was tested. Hoops: new spin move on U (a full 360 round your man, ball palmed on the hip, defenders leaning the wrong way get left behind; the CPU uses it too), afterimage streaks on crossovers, spins and step-backs, a flame trail on shots when you're on fire, a scrolling LED board round the arena that flashes on swishes, and light beams over the court.
